name: Muse Number Five — five-slot manual scenario
purpose: Proposed manual coverage for the five agent slots and six-tab shell. This JSON records no execution result.

release_gate.note: The source describes this 22-step slot flow as a release gate. Detailed D11 acceptance criteria were not supplied. Do not mark passed until the owner supplies criteria and a real run records evidence.
